title: Top Lawmakers Agree A.I.’s Risks Are Rising but Say They Have No Quick Fix
summary: House Speaker Mike Johnson warned on Sunday of competitive risks from China, and Hakeem Jeffries, the minority leader, said Congress should start regulatory talks this week.
